title: Extract the percentage discount rule out of Cart into PercentDiscount
requirement: Move the percentage discount rule out of Cart into a new final class PhpMini\Shop\PercentDiscount in src/PercentDiscount.php. Its constructor takes the whole-number percentage and throws InvalidArgumentException outside 0-100; percent(): int returns it; applyTo(Money $amount): Money returns the amount reduced by the discount, rounded half up to the cent, in the amount's currency. Cart::totalWithPercentDiscount(int $percent) must keep its signature and behaviour exactly (including the exception for an out-of-range percentage) and delegate to PercentDiscount, so the rule lives in one place. No behaviour change.
